facts.fact: 万圣节，穿白床单、挖了眼洞的朱利安拿着南瓜灯形状的塑料桶来讨糖，哈蒂一眼认出他的眼睛。
facts.anchor: The small, sheeted figure with eyeholes cut out holds a plastic bucket in the shape of a jack-o’-lantern.

facts.fact: 哈蒂去食品储藏室找出一条留着烘焙用的巧克力棒，放进朱利安的空桶里。
facts.anchor: Hattie goes to her pantry and finds a chocolate bar she reserved for baking and drops it into Julian’s empty bucket.

facts.fact: 温迪说他们要去北边的 Lakefield 而不是在附近街区讨糖，话说到一半没讲完。
facts.anchor: But we’re going north to Lakefield instead of hitting any of the neighborhoods around here just because . . .

facts.fact: 温迪说心理学家昨天和朱利安谈了一个多小时，说他很聪明，可能比原先以为的还聪明。
facts.anchor: She spent over an hour with him yesterday. She said he’s very intelligent.

facts.fact: 凯文补充说心理学家下次会谈时要给朱利安做智商测试。
facts.anchor: She’s going to give him an IQ test during the next session

facts.fact: 哈蒂从冰箱拿了一罐汽水放进朱利安的桶里。
facts.anchor: Hattie grabs a can of soda from the fridge, depositing it in Julian’s bucket.

facts.fact: 哈蒂向朱利安道歉，说昨天因为海鸥的事吓到了他。
facts.anchor: I’m sorry for scaring you yesterday. About the seagull.

facts.fact: 朱利安说没有东西会真正死去。
朱利安头也不回地穿过院子、消失在树林里。
facts.anchor: Without a look back he glides across the yard and disappears into the trees
